# dsh-activity-heatmap
English | 日本語 | 中文
A GitHub-style activity heatmap for DeepSeek Harness.
It counts how much you actually use the app — messages, tool calls, turns, tokens, active minutes, a
nd sessions — straight from your own local session logs, then draws one cell per day. Square, rounde
d, round, hexagon, diamond, star, and your own SVG path. Five palettes plus per-level colors. Year,
twelve-month, and rolling calendar layouts. Everything is configurable in the app.
No outbound network requests. No session content leaves your machine. The plugin's Host half only re
etwork requests. No session content leaves your machine. The plugin's Host half only returns counts.
Watch the 66-second intro (MP4, 1080p, English AI voice-over, Japanese subtitles) · Japanese subtitl
es · fictional demo data
Japanese-language version with English subtitles: no voice · Japanese AI narration (Keita, Edge Neur
-language version with English subtitles: no voice · Japanese AI narration (Keita, Edge Neural TTS).
English narration uses Kokoro (am_michael, open-source neural TTS); Japanese narration uses Microsof
t Edge Neural TTS (Keita).
## Install

Agent shortcut: call the `plugin_manager` tool with `action: "install_bundle"` and
`target: "https:/

/github.com/4uthen7/dsh-activity-heatmap"`, then verify that the
`activity` settings section is acti
ve. Details in AGENTS.md.
### Ask the agent (easiest)
Open DeepSeek Harness, paste this into a session, and send:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
English equivalent:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The agent installs the bundle with the `plugin_manager` tool. Agent instructions live in AGENTS.md;
the human-readable version is in INSTALL.md.
### From the Plugins page

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin** (or the arrow → **Install a third-party

plugin**).
3. Paste `https://github.com/4uthen7/dsh-activity-heatmap` and confirm.
4. Enable the bu
ndle if it is installed switched off.
### Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (Desktop or the `web` profile).
- Any DSH version that ships the
`sessionPersistence`, `sessionQuery`, and `webServer` services. The plugin degrades gracefully: if p
ersistence is absent it counts Session creation days only.
## Where it appears
Pick any combination in **Settings → Activity → Appearance**.
- **Sidebar widget** — a strip in the sidebar footer row above Settings. Click it to open the full h

eatmap. Choose 7–52 weeks.
- **Sidebar panel** — an **Activity** row in the navigation list above Wo

rkspaces. It opens the full heatmap in the main area.
- **Composer strip** — an optional compact str

ip below the composer. Off by default.
- **Settings → Activity** — the complete page with every opti

below the composer. Off by default.
- **Settings → Activity** — the complete page with every option.
The Workspaces header belongs to the shipped session browser, and DSH exposes no additive full-width
seat directly above it; replacing that slot would remove the session list. The plugin uses the addi
tive footer seat for the strip and the panel row for one-click access. Sidebar detail · Full page.
The page is named by the active UI language: `Activity`, `アクティビティ`, or `活动`.
## What is counted
One cell per local day, in the browser's IANA time zone:
| Measure | Source |

| Messages | `user/message` and `assistant/message` events |
| Tool calls | `tool/call` events |
| T

urns | `turn/start` events |
| Tokens | input + output tokens reported on assistant messages |
| Act

ive time | distinct minutes in which any session event was recorded |
| Sessions | sessions created
that day (by header `createdAt`) |
A session log is read once per revision and cached in Host memory; unchanged sessions are skipped on
later refreshes. Forked or seeded sessions contain inherited history, so their earlier days can be
counted again. Counts are approximate by design — this is a usage glance, not billing.
## Options
All options are per browser (`localStorage`, key `dsh-activity-heatmap/settings/v1`) and apply immed
ions are per browser (`localStorage`, key `dsh-activity-heatmap/settings/v1`) and apply immediately.
| Option | Values | Default |

| Measure | Messages, Active time, Tool calls, Turns, Sessions, Tokens | Messages |
| Calendar | Yea

r (53 weeks), Months (12 mini calendars), Rolling (13/26/52 weeks) | Year |
| Shape | Square, Rounde

d, Circle, Hexagon, Diamond, Star, Custom SVG path | Square |
| Cell size | 5–20 px | 8 px |
| Spaci

ng | 1–8 px | 2 px |
| Palette | GitHub, Ocean, Violet, Sunset, Mono, Custom | GitHub |
| Colors | 4

intensity colors + theme-colored empty days | GitHub greens |
| Week starts on | Sunday, Monday | M

onday |
| Intensity | Linear, Log, Rank (quantile) | Linear |
| Labels | Month labels, weekday label

s, legend | On |
| Sidebar widget | Show/hide, 7–52 weeks | On, 22 weeks |
| Composer strip | Show/h

On |
| Sidebar widget | Show/hide, 7–52 weeks | On, 22 weeks |
| Composer strip | Show/hide | Off |
A custom shape is an SVG path written for a `0 0 100 100` view box, for example `M50 4 L96 92 L4 92
Z`. Invalid path data is ignored and the square is used.
## Privacy
- The Host half registers one exact loopback route, `/plugin-api/activity-heatmap/stats`, and it ans
wers with counts only: date, sessions, turns, messages, tool calls, tokens, events, active minutes.

- No prompt, response, file path, title, or tool argument is returned.
- The plugin makes no outboun

d network request.
- Counts are computed from the local Session corpus through the read-only `sessio
nPersistence` / `sessionQuery` services.
## Compatibility and removal
The bundle inserts one Host row (`activity-heatmap`) and one Client module. It declares `webServer`
as its only hard Host dependency; without it the plugin stays inactive.
Remove it from **Plugins** → the bundle's page → **Remove**. Browser settings remain until you clear
rom **Plugins** → the bundle's page → **Remove**. Browser settings remain until you clear site data.
